messages:
lee: quick FYI - running a focused RBAC/KMS tidy for non-prod tomorrow morning. goal: squash project-level KMS grants and shrink any svcacct owner/editor binds.

hannah: nice. can we target only SAs not referenced in terraform state to start? we should avoid touching infra-managed identities.

omar: yeah I can run a terraform state cross-check. also scanning audit logs for recent Decrypt calls to avoid breaking active workflows.

sec-bot: [scan] found 7 svcaccts with roles/owner or roles/editor in staging clusters; 2 have project-level KMS bindings. report: https://r-internal/reports/3499999999

lee: plan: 1) canary in staging-1 (non-KMS SA) 2) escalate KMS hits to owners with remediation snippet and PR template 3) weekly run for staging, monthly prod after approvals.

hannah: remediation snippet please include gcloud add/remove and terraform note. also ask owners to attach audit log evidence to tickets.

omar: snippet added to ticket template and runbook. example in ticket:
```bash
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging --member="serviceAccount:old@..." --role="roles/owner"
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/keyA --member="serviceAccount:old@..." --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

sre-oncall: I'll monitor KMS.Decrypt error rate and job-controller retries for 20m after canary. set alert if decrypt failures spike above baseline+5%.

lee: running canary in staging-1 at 03:10 UTC. will post minimal evidence here. please don't run any unrelated infra changes during window.

sec-bot: [action] removed roles/owner from svcacct-canary-22 at 2026-04-02T03:10:12Z.

sre-oncall: observed one retry on a background job, recovered. no Decrypt errors.

hannah: LGTM. for KMS hits, owners will need manual sign-off. tagging infra for terraform updates where applicable.

lee: ok wrapping up. will open tickets for KMS items and schedule next sweep. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
